name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade: Ratio Z-Score with Copper/Gold Regime
description: Pairs trading analysis of FCX (copper miner) vs NEM (gold miner). Computes the FCX/NEM price ratio, applies a 120-day rolling z-score, and identifies mean-reversion opportunities at ±2σ extremes. Uses the HG/GC (copper-to-gold) futures ratio z-score as a macro regime indicator: risk-on (z > 0) vs risk-off (z ≤ 0). Forward return analysis is split by regime to test whether mean reversion works better in one environment. Outputs: z-score time series with regime shading, scatter of z-score vs forward returns, event markers at each entry, and regime-split summary statistics.
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pair Trade — Ratio Z-Score & Mean Reversion
# With Copper/Gold (HG/GC) Regime Indicator
# 120-day z-score on price ratio, ±2σ entry thresholds
# Regime: HG/GC ratio z-score > 0 = risk-on, ≤ 0 = risk-off

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
ts = index().value
fcx_close = src.c
nem_close = nem.c

# --- Copper/Gold Regime Data ---
hg_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()
gc_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)
gc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# Copper/gold ratio and its z-score (regime signal)
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
cu_au_z = zscore(window=120)(cu_au_ratio)

# Regime: risk-on when copper/gold z > 0, risk-off when ≤ 0
is_risk_on = is_valid(cu_au_z) and cu_au_z > 0.0
is_risk_off = is_valid(cu_au_z) and cu_au_z <= 0.0

# --- Price Ratio & Z-Score ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close
ratio_z = zscore(window=120)(ratio)

# --- Rolling Correlation (context) ---
fcx_ret = returns(period=1)(fcx_close)
nem_ret = returns(period=1)(nem_close)
corr_120d = rolling_corr(window=120)(fcx_ret, nem_ret)

# --- Signal Detection ---
# Long FCX when ratio is cheap (z < -2), short FCX when ratio is rich (z > +2)
long_signal = is_valid(ratio_z) and ratio_z < -2.0
short_signal = is_valid(ratio_z) and ratio_z > 2.0

# --- Regime-Split Signals (no compound `or` — each combo is its own boolean) ---
long_riskon = long_signal and is_risk_on
long_riskoff = long_signal and is_risk_off
short_riskon = short_signal and is_risk_on
short_riskoff = short_signal and is_risk_off

# Forward returns on FCX at signal points (research — look-ahead)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(fcx_close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(fcx_close)

# --- Forward returns split by direction AND regime ---
# Long signals (expect FCX to rally)
long_ro_fwd20 = where(long_riskon, fwd_20d)
long_rf_fwd20 = where(long_riskoff, fwd_20d)

# Short signals (expect FCX to drop — negate for P&L)
short_ro_fwd20 = where(short_riskon, -1.0 * fwd_20d)
short_rf_fwd20 = where(short_riskoff, -1.0 * fwd_20d)

# Hit rates per regime×direction (1.0 if profitable, 0.0 if not)
long_ro_hit = where(long_riskon, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
long_rf_hit = where(long_riskoff, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
short_ro_hit = where(short_riskon, 1.0 if fwd_20d < 0 else 0.0)
short_rf_hit = where(short_riskoff, 1.0 if fwd_20d < 0 else 0.0)

# Z-score at entry for scatter (separate per direction, all regimes)
long_fwd_20d = where(long_signal, fwd_20d)
short_fwd_20d = where(short_signal, -1.0 * fwd_20d)

# Regime band for chart overlay (1 when risk-on, 0 when risk-off)
regime_band = 1.0 if is_risk_on else 0.0

# --- Event Markers: Long FCX (Ratio Cheap) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long FCX — Ratio Cheap',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Regime Z', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio_z, fcx_close, cu_au_z, fwd_20d, long_signal)

# --- Event Markers: Short FCX (Ratio Rich) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Short FCX — Ratio Rich',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Regime Z', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio_z, fcx_close, cu_au_z, fwd_20d, short_signal)

# --- Output 1: Z-Score Time Series with ±2σ Bands + Regime Shading ---
xy_lines(
    title='Is the FCX/NEM Ratio at an Extreme?',
    category='Pair Trade Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (120d)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ratio Z-Score', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Risk-On Regime (Cu/Au z > 0)', color=Color.Green, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='+2σ (Short FCX)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-2σ (Long FCX)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Fair Value')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=2.0, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Rich'),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-2.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label='Cheap')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio_z, regime_band))

# --- Output 2: Scatter — Z-Score at Entry vs 20d Forward Return ---
xy_scatter(
    title='Do Extremes Predict Mean Reversion?',
    category='Pair Trade Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Z-Score at Entry',
    y_axis_label='20-Day Forward Return (FCX)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Long FCX (z < -2)', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Short FCX (z > +2)', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=ratio_z, y_values=(long_fwd_20d, short_fwd_20d))

# --- Output 3: Regime-Split Summary Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Pair Trade Analysis',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Mean Reversion by Cu/Au Regime (20d Horizon)',
        row_size=4, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Long FCX — Risk-On', 'Long FCX — Risk-Off', 'Short FCX — Risk-On', 'Short FCX — Risk-Off'],
        col_headers=['N (Signals)', 'Median 20d Ret', 'Hit Rate', 'Worst 20d Ret'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(long_ro_fwd20, long_ro_fwd20, long_ro_hit, long_ro_fwd20, long_rf_fwd20, long_rf_fwd20, long_rf_hit, long_rf_fwd20, short_ro_fwd20, short_ro_fwd20, short_ro_hit, short_ro_fwd20, short_rf_fwd20, short_rf_fwd20, short_rf_hit, short_rf_fwd20)
